title: Thalang: Phuket's Quiet North, for Renters and Buyers
excerpt: Thalang has some of the best-value family houses in Phuket: we list 46 rentals at a median of ฿45,000 a month and 23 homes for sale. Where to look, what it costs, and who it suits.
author: Islander Home Team
content:
Thalang covers much of northern Phuket, stretching from the old town around the Heroines' Monument to Pa Khlok on the east coast and Mai Khao near the airport. It is quieter and greener than the south, with new housing estates, the Robinson Thalang shopping centre, and UWC Thailand and Thanyapura nearby. For families looking for more space, it is often one of the best-value areas on the island.

The figures below are based on our listings as of mid-October 2026.

Renting in Thalang

We list 46 homes for rent in Thalang, with a median rent of ฿45,000 a month. Almost all are houses rather than condos.

Expect to pay ฿26,000 to ฿50,000 for a three-bedroom house. Most rentals are three-bedroom family homes in gated estates such as Supalai Bella, Supalai Primo and Anasiri, often with access to a shared pool and gym. Nine of the listings are marked pet-friendly.

  • A furnished three-bedroom at Wongchalerm Garden Ville: ฿26,000 a month
  • A three-bedroom family home in Supalai Bella: ฿45,000 a month
  • A four-bedroom with a shared pool and gym at Anasiri: ฿55,000 a month
  • A pool villa near UWC and Thanyapura: ฿45,000 a month

Who Thalang suits

  • Families. Enjoy more space, gardens and quiet estates, with UWC Thailand and Thanyapura nearby.
  • Frequent flyers. Phuket's airport is located in the far north of the district.
  • Boat owners. Pa Khlok offers convenient access to Yacht Haven and Ao Po Grand Marina.
  • Buyers looking for a pool villa under ฿20 million. Fourteen of the seventeen villas for sale are priced below that amount.

The trade-off is the drive. Patong, Kata and the southern beaches are 45 minutes or more away, while Bang Tao and Laguna are about 20 to 30 minutes away, depending on your location. If you want to walk to the beach, consider Bang Tao or Rawai instead.
